result.title: Non-Parametric Mutual Information Estimation with Vine Copulas
result.comment: Accepted at the conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026)
result.summary: We introduce VINE: a non-parametric mutual information (MI) estimator based on simplified D-vine copulas. Approximating the joint density with a simplified D-vine allows the density ratio to simplify to a product of pair copulas, which we can estimate non-parametrically. This structural simplification yields VINE, a flexible and computationally efficient MI estimator. We compare VINE against SotA neural MI estimators on a range of datasets, both under settings where the simplified D-vine assumption holds and where it is violated, demonstrating competitive accuracy at a lower computational cost for low- to medium-dimensional datasets.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 VINE，一种基于简化 D-vine copula 的非参数互信息估计器：用简化 D-vine 近似联合密度，使密度比化简为成对 copula 的乘积并逐项非参数估计，在低至中维数据上以更低计算成本取得与神经 MI 估计器相当（competitive）的精度。
AI.relevance_reason: 互信息估计可作为量化 latent 状态保留多少视觉证据、诊断信息坍缩或做贡献分配的工具线索；但该方法仅在低中维数据上验证，能否用于 VLM 高维隐状态与视觉证据之间的 MI 度量可供核查。
